description:
The renowned adventurer, Reon.    
He takes on the mission to rescue the captured villagers after passing through a raided village.    
However, what awaited him was a horrible nightmare that would shred his pride and body...     
What will be the fate of Reon, who became the goblins' prey?

Read official Japanese, English and Korean versions on BOOTH, [DLsite](https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ01488268.html), Itch.io and [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/posts/japanese-update-141017221). Also available (only in Korean) on [Postype](https://www.postype.com/@henenillust/series/1291882).
